text: What if I told you I made $15,000 in passive income selling one single product on Amazon FBA as a single mom with zero business background and it only cost me less than $5,000. Yeah, I didn't believe it either, but it actually happened. Whether you're a stay-at-home parent stuck in a 9 to-5 or just tired of waiting for the right moment, this might be the turning point you've been waiting for. And if you already started or are thinking of starting an Amazon FBA business, I'm going to share three big mistakes that I made and almost all new Amazon sellers make that you don't want to miss. I am Tanya. Not long ago, I was a single mom sewing leotards for living, exhausted, overworked, and barely making it through the day. I didn't hate my life, but I felt stuck. My days were a blur of stitching fabric and putting everyone else first, including my kids, until suddenly the kids were grown, off to college, and I was left wondering what now. Then that's when something shifted. I didn't want to just stay busy anymore. I wanted to take control of my life. But here's the problem. Everywhere I look, the people succeeding online were mostly men with big startup budget, tech skills, or hours of free time I just didn't have. I couldn't drop 10,000 on inventory. I couldn't spend 10 hours a day learning a brand new system. But I could feel something in my gut. I needed to create passive income, a business that made money while I lived my life. That's when I found Amazon FBA. I binged video after video watching different coaches trying to figure out who I could really trust. And that's when I discovered Travis Marziani. His approach felt clear, simple, doable, no fluff, just a road map for people like me who wanted to build something meaningful without feeling overwhelmed. And I'm so grateful to choose his program because it helped me realize something powerful. My passion isn't just business. It's helping people feel inspired and worthy every day. And that's why I created my product, Inspire Now Affirmation Cards for Daily Motivation. And within one year, everything changed. I didn't just launch a product. I built a business. I built confidence. I found my dream life partner. And we just bought a beautiful house together. Most affirmation cards say something like, "I am enough." And that's great. Unless you are having a really bad day and don't feel enough, then what? Just reading a sentence doesn't change anything. That's why I created affirmation cards with three parts. The affirmation like I'm enough, the explanation so you understand why it matters, and the action step. A simple way to apply it so the words actually sink into your life. These cards help me stay grounded while building this business. And now we're helping other people, too. I know that because all of my reviews have been organic and all very positive. My reviews speak for themselves. So, if you're feeling stuck, lost, or wondering if you could ever build something of your own, stick around because in this video, I'm going to show you exactly how I turned $4,650 into over $15,000 in passive income and how you can do it, too, and some of the mistakes I made so you don't repeat them. So, here is exactly what it cost me to start my FBA business from scratch. The first cost is doing market research, but I skipped this step because I was launching a passion product. And Travis recommends two paths for launching products. One is passion product and the second is if you don't have a product idea that you want to make and want help finding your product idea, Travis has lots of tutorials on how to use this research tool called Helium 10 to find profitable product ideas. And this leads me into my first mistake, which is not validating your product idea. If you're selling a passion product, use social media to test demand before you launch. Build a small following on Tik Tok, Instagram, or even a Facebook group. Get people excited. If you validate your idea before launch, your chances of success and getting more sales skyrocket. And I believe I missed out on lots of sales because I skipped this step. So, I don't recommend it. But if you don't want to be on social media, there is a faster, easier way. Just use Helium 10 to find products that people are already searching for, but no one is selling well on Amazon. And Travis has tutorials that make it easy. So, the very first thing I invested in was the design work. I paid $1,500 to bring my vision to life. custom cards, my logo, the packaging, and professional product photos. It wasn't cheap, but it made my product look like a premium brand from day one. If you don't want to spend that much on design, I actually found a company called FBA Creatives that will do that creative hard work for you for a much lower price. This team of experts can create your product, images, logo, and branding, and your packaging. plus build your entire listing, description, bullet points for you, all under one roof. After that, I got my trademark for just $300. I did it all by myself online. No lawyers, no complications. It was a step-by-step video that I followed through Travis's program. Same thing with my LLC and DBA that was $140 and took me like 15 minutes to set up online. Then there is the Amazon seller fee, $39.99 a month. Small cost, but it's a huge opportunity. Now, where it gets exciting. I found the perfect manufacturer through Travis's program. I spent just over 2,500 to produce my first batch of 500 units, plus $20 on samples. Shipping was included with the order, but I paid another $50 to get everything sent into Amazon's warehouse. There were a few more fees, but in total, I spent just 4,650 to launch my business. No background in business, no fancy degrees, no investors, just a simple product, a clear step-by-step plan, and a guidance from an incredible mentor. And now that 4,650 has turned into $15,000 in passive income, even with a huge mistake that cost me over $10,000 in missed sales, which I'll explain in just a bit so you don't repeat it. I launched my product in March 2024, and in the first three months, I made just over $1,650 in sales. But here's the part nobody talks about. That's revenue, not profit. I sold 83 units and the product cost me $437 to make. But with Amazon, there are other fees you need to factor into. $248 Amazon referral fees, $323 FBA pick and pack fee. That's the money Amazon takes automatically by storing, packaging, and shipping your product. My total profit for the first 3 months was just under $650. But here's why that still felt amazing. I didn't do anything. All the work was done upfront and once my product was live, I literally just watched the money roll in. Even better, the sales were growing every month. Months one, 11 units. Months two, 30 plus units. months, three almost 40 units. I could feel it. It was real. My business was working. In the seven months after launch, for the rest of 2024, I made almost $8,000 in revenue. And after subtracting my expenses, I earned over $3,000 in passive income profit. And I want to emphasize this was all happening while I lived my life. I wasn't packing orders. I wasn't answering customer emails. That's the magic of Amazon FBA. You do the work once and the sales happen in the background. Suddenly, I was consistently selling 50 plus units a month. And then came December, the holidays. My affirmation cards were the perfect gift idea. I made over $1,200 in sales that month alone, my highest revenue month of the entire year. Orders came in fast. Inventory started flying off the shelves. People were gifting my product inspire now affirmation cards to loved ones who needed motivation and encouragement. And that honestly felt incredible. I wasn't just making money. I was making people lives better. and the reviews on my listing reflect how satisfied my customers are. But that leads me into my second mistake, which is inventory management. In my first nine months, I sold out. I wasn't watching my inventory and I went out of stock. And when that happens, your Amazon rating drops fast. Sales were booming and suddenly they weren't. So take it from me, always track your inventory. If you run out, your momentum disappears and it's so hard to get it back. In 2024, I made 3,650 in net profit. In 2025, only 1,900. I should have made more. And this leads me to my third mistake that I made and I believe all of us made, which is not starting earlier. I kept improving the product. I kept tweaking. I kept thinking this design or this design how it would look better and I kept procrastinating and postponing the launch date and I wish I just launched however it was and it would have brought me so many more sales by starting earlier. I started this journey because I wanted passive income with automatic PPC built-in tools and everything I've learned. I'm excited to keep growing in 2025 and beyond. And I know you can do this, too. Seriously, joining Travis's passion product formula changed my life.
